manifest.query_encoder: Swift Core ML, int8-compressed weights, float16 compute
manifest.performance_note: Mac only. Embedding shared between retrieval arms of one query; component times are explicit. Corpus/index/model loading excluded from query timings.

excluded_cases.new-astronomy-1: Standalone Saturn does not specify mythology versus planet.

review_method: Single-assistant manual support review. Exact case/text matches reuse prior reviews. Every admitted output requires a text-bound label. Not an independent or blinded factuality evaluation.
limitations: Reviewed-complete questions are an oracle, not a learned resolver.
Original questions search without conversation topic reuse.
Core support does not certify every source claim.
Previously used 75-case suite; not a new held-out benchmark.
Mac timings, no iPhone latency or battery measurement.
Union preparation is shared; component medians must not be summed as per-arm end-to-end latency.
